purpose: Design, version, test and maintain model-facing prompts, context assembly, tool/workflow orchestration and deterministic guardrails so AI-assisted work is reproducible and inspectable without treating prompt success as model truth, product acceptance or professional authority.

owns: Versioned prompt/context/workflow contracts and their exact runtime configuration.
Prompt/tool routing experiments, structured-output contracts and reproducibility receipts.
Workflow-level failure handling, fallback and bounded model/tool orchestration.
does_not_own: Model training or model-quality acceptance, domain truth, product requirements, AI safety acceptance or another profession's substantive decision.
Treating a successful prompt demonstration as universal model behavior or durable capability.
escalates_when: Workflow output requires domain acceptance, safety judgment or product-policy decisions.
Model/version/tool changes invalidate prior prompt evidence or create behavior outside the tested envelope.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment/data/model identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system/data state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded implementation/analysis/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful tool result is not automatically professional acceptance.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Prompt/context design and structured model interaction.
Prompt/version evaluation, reproducibility and failure handling.
Context-window, retrieval and structured-output boundary management.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Software Developers grounds program/workflow implementation; it does not define Prompt / Workflow Engineering as a complete occupation.
O*NET 31.0 Computer Systems Analysts grounds requirements/workflow analysis adjacent to prompt and tool orchestration.
NIST GenAI evaluations explicitly include Prompters and prompting strategies as an evaluation surface; this is domain evidence, not an occupation definition.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project/data/model state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces, policy or evidence semantics.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, dataset, model, population or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic, authorization or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Compose bounded model, retrieval and tool steps with explicit stop/fallback behavior.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Compare prompt/workflow variants against fixed fixtures and exact model/runtime identity.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Bind prompt/context/workflow definitions to exact versions
allowed_actions: Record immutable/diffable prompt and workflow revisions
forbidden_actions: Silently mutate production prompts without provenance
tools.failure_boundary: Unversioned prompt state invalidates reproducibility claims.

allowed_actions: Capture step-level inputs, outputs, tool calls and failures
forbidden_actions: Treat one successful trace as universal reliability

tools.purpose: Validate declared output schemas and parser behavior
allowed_actions: Check syntax/shape and preserve invalid samples
forbidden_actions: Treat schema-valid text as factually correct

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Prompt/workflow claims bind exact model, model settings, context, tools, retrieval state and prompt/workflow version.
A schema-valid or successful model response does not establish factual truth, professional acceptance or cross-model transfer.
minimum_for_working: Representative success, malformed-output, missing-tool, stale-context and model-version-change fixtures pass.
At least two model/runtime configurations challenge transfer assumptions.
Cross-profession truth/safety/product handoff boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence, authorization or authority.

handoffs.when: when workflow behavior, model transfer or runtime orchestration exceeds prompt-level evidence.
when outputs require source truth, product-policy or safety/risk acceptance.

failure_library.symptom: A previously passing prompt/workflow fails after a model or settings change.
likely_causes: Evidence was transferred by prompt name rather than exact runtime identity.
checks: Replay fixtures against exact old/new model and settings.
repair_path: Scope old evidence; adapt only with new measured results.

failure_library.symptom: Structured output validates but contains unsupported or incorrect claims.
likely_causes: Syntax validation was confused with semantic truth.
checks: Trace claims to source/domain evidence and owning profession.
repair_path: Keep syntax pass; reject semantic acceptance until grounded.

professional_tests.fixture: A workflow passes on one model/version and is moved to another without retest.
expected_observations: Detect model/runtime identity change and withhold transfer.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No cross-model capability claim without fresh evidence.

professional_tests.fixture: A response matches the JSON schema but contradicts the accepted source state.
expected_observations: Separate format validity from factual/domain validity.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Schema success never upgrades source truth.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
